description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) for filtering employee timesheet list searches in the OrangeHRM system. It encapsulates filter criteria like employee numbers and actionable states, and sets default sorting parameters.

classes.name: EmployeeTimesheetListSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for specifying search filters for employee timesheets, including employee number filters and actionable states, with default sort configuration.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters with default sort field and order.

methods.name: getEmployeeNumbers
methods.description: Returns the list of employee numbers used as a filter criteria.

methods.name: setEmployeeNumbers
methods.description: Sets the list of employee numbers for filtering.

methods.name: getActionableStatesList
methods.description: Returns the list of actionable states used as a filter criteria.

methods.name: setActionableStatesList
methods.description: Sets the list of actionable states for filtering.
